subject: Orion marketplace interop scope & rollback agreement
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna.li@orioncloud.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion marketplace interop scope & rollback agreement

Team —

Looping you in on the OrionCloud marketplace listing request. They want to go live in Q2 and have a handful of non-standard prerequisites (listed in the attached workbook) that intersect infra, SDK surface, and our entitlement checks. High-level asks:

- Confirm whether we can accept the SSO metadata format they send (they use SAML2.1 with an extra "issuer_alias" field).
- Determine if we can support their custom entitlement token header (X-Orion-Ent) without an agent change (is routing/validation configurable in Dedicated?).
- Identify minimum telemetry hooks required for their marketplace (they want request_id + tenant_id logged per LLM call).
- Produce a short rollback/canary playbook in case the listing impacts other partners.

Attachments: orion-connector-prereqs.xlsx (spreadsheet of items they marked mandatory vs optional)

Please reply with owners and feasibility (green/yellow/red) and rough ETA for any dev work. I put Jenna from Orion on CC to keep them in the loop for clarifying questions.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0174

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna.li@orioncloud.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orion marketplace interop scope & rollback agreement

Thanks Aditya — quick read-through and notes below. I also attached a two-page draft rollback playbook (proposed-rollback-playbook.md).

Summary of feasibility by line item (from the workbook):
- SSO metadata (issuer_alias) — YELLOW. Our SAML parser accepts standard fields; adding a small adapter to map issuer_alias to issuer_id is a low-risk change but needs a config flag. Rough ETA: 2 dev days + 1 day QA. Owner: Mateo.
- X-Orion-Ent header validation — RED unless we accept a validation stub. Right now entitlement validation is tightly coupled with our entitlement service and supported header names are whitelisted. If Orion can provide a signed JWT alternative we can validate without runtime change. Otherwise requires a gate change (3 dev days). Owner: Marissa.
- Telemetry hooks (request_id + tenant_id) — GREEN. We already log request_id; tenant_id is available in Dedicated via routing metadata and can be plumbed into token-level logs. ETA: 1 dev day to add mapping + 1 day infra. Owner: Mateo.

Open product questions for the thread:
1) Can we approve a config-flag approach for SAML aliasing for all marketplace partners (risk: proliferation of flags)?
2) For entitlement header acceptance, can Legal sign an explicit assumption/limitation (we would not be changing entitlement semantics, only accepting an alternate header that maps to an existing token) — need Legal input from Orion.
3) Canary/rollback scope: do we want listing-level isolation (i.e., pin routing to a dedicated pool for first 48 hours) or do we rely on model-variant fallbacks? My recommendation: dedicated pool for first 24–48 hours + automatic routing fallback after 60s latency spike.

Jenna — if Orion can confirm flexibility on the entitlement token format and whether Legal can sign a short addendum, we can keep this low touch.

--
Laura Bennett
Product Manager, Integrations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

[Attachment: proposed-rollback-playbook.md (md)]
From: Samir Patel <samir@orioncloud.com>
To: Jenna Li <jenna.li@orioncloud.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: OrionCloud Legal <legal@orioncloud.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orion marketplace interop scope & rollback agreement

Hi all — thanks for the quick analysis. Quick responses:

- Entitlement: we cannot easily provide a JWT; our platform emits a signed header (X-Orion-Ent) today. Legal is willing to sign an addendum if Redwood restricts acceptance to mapping-only (no semantic change). I copied Legal.
- SAML alias: we can emit issuer_alias or a canonical issuer_id; we can add whichever is easier for you.
- Telemetry: request_id and tenant_id are fine — we can provide those in the initial crawl traffic.

On the rollback: we prefer dedicated pool isolation for the first 48 hours. Orion can also throttle traffic during the rollout window. Proposed timeline: start listing on Monday 2027-03-29, monitor 48 hours, then expand routing.

Legal (OrionCloud Legal) — can you confirm you can sign the addendum that maps X-Orion-Ent to Redwood's entitlement header for the initial listing window only? If yes, we'll need a short DocuSign link.

Thanks —
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, OrionCloud
samir@orioncloud.com

[Attachment: orion-legal-addendum-request.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna.li@orioncloud.com>, Samir Patel <samir@orioncloud.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orion marketplace interop scope & rollback agreement

Appreciate the context — quick ops confirmation and proposed runbook edits.

1) Canary gating: we can provision a small Dedicated pool and pin Orion routing there for the first 48 hours. Ops impact: a 2–4 GPU burst reserve will be needed; CX/finance notified.
2) Auto-fallback policy: if 5xx rate increases by >1% or 95th latency > 3s for 2 consecutive 5-minute windows, automatically route new sessions to the previous stable model variant.
3) Rollback playbook additions (added to proposed-rollback-playbook.md):
   - Emergency de-list flow (manual trigger + automated traffic drain)
   - Sidecar monitoring to ensure tenant-level telemetry is captured for billing reconciliation
   - Post-incident postmortem owner: Mateo (deliverable within 7 days)

Next steps:
- Laura: confirm whether config-flag for SAML alias is acceptable at product level (we'll keep it behind feature-flag).
- Marissa: I will open a capacity ticket and reserve burst GPUs (ETA: EOD Monday).
- Aditya: coordinate with Orion Legal for the DocuSign link and share once available.

I'll mark this thread as ready for scheduling once we have the addendum.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Attachment: proposed-rollback-playbook.md (updated)]
